title: DecisionResult v1
description: What the Decision layer returns. AGENT_CONTRACTS section 7.2. The runtime validates this against the legal action set before acting on it, so a model that names an illegal stage or agent is refused rather than obeyed — the rules are the runtime's, not the model's.

intent.description: A short label for what the agent understood the user to want.

reasonSummary.description: An auditable summary of why this action was chosen. It is a summary rather than the model's reasoning: SECURITY section 7 and AGENT_CONTRACTS section 16 both require the record to be reviewable without asking for private chain of thought.

userMessage.description: What to show the user. It is model output, so it is displayed as text and never parsed.

agentKey.description: Required when the type runs an agent; the runtime refuses a key that is not registered for that layer.

stage.description: The stage to run. The runtime refuses one the workflow's next-step rules do not allow.

input.description: Arguments for the stage. It is passed through to the Execution agent's request, so the schema here stays open while the execution contract stays closed.
